title: DHCP: Automatic IP Assignment

steps.objective: Enter privileged mode to explore DHCP concepts
steps.teachingPoint: DHCP automatically assigns IP addresses to network devices
DHCP pools appear as 'ip dhcp pool' sections in config

legacyCommands: ! DHCP REFERENCE - Router as DHCP Server:
! - Pool name can be anything (LAN_POOL is common)
! - 'network' defines the subnet to assign from
! - 'default-router' is the gateway for DHCP clients
! - 'dns-server' tells clients which DNS to use
! - Excluded addresses are reserved (won't be assigned)
! - Always exclude the router interface IP!
